name: Autobot
description: Private AI for Android and iOS, with chat, agents, images and voice. On-device by default, with remote providers by choice.

name: Invincible
description: Run models and agents on hardware you own. Route remote calls by policy and connect your devices to one self-hosted endpoint.

name: Niobium
description: Connect to Hermes or run DSH locally. Give your agents distinct personas and companions, with their own chats and rooms. Full Hermes parity is still in development.

name: Omnie
description: Omnie is being built for app and data connections. First: pull project/account data from e-conomic through Omnie Connect and use it to build reports in Omnie.

name: Polykrom
description: Parametric CAD in Rust with an AI companion. A fork of SolidCraft, with shared fixes contributed upstream. Current 3D-kernel development is PolyCore; Nightfall is archived research.

name: PolyCore
description: The Rust geometry kernel under Polykrom, and planned for Trigon: one kernel, so a fix for one app is a fix for both. Nightfall is archived research, not the active kernel.

name: Trigon
description: Free and open-source architectural and civil building modelling. Start from an address, lay out facades with parametric components, and export IFC4 and drawings, by hand or through an AI agent over MCP. Denmark first; built to run on PolyCore.

name: Tinyrex
description: An 18-joint bipedal T-rex design and a browser learning lab: explore joints, balance and leg kinematics with simplified models.

name: Creed
description: Engineering values, ten task skills and verification tools. A practical guide for agents: evidence over assertion, reversible changes and contracts kept.

name: Nightfall
description: Archived. The app continues as Polykrom; the kernel work continues in PolyCore, a new Rust kernel.

name: Axit
description: Fast file search, storage maps and reviewed cleanup in a Rust TUI. Keyboard and mouse, application management, MCP and ACP.

name: OpenEndo
description: An open data hub for endometriosis research: clinical trials, papers, funding and policy, with a separate discovery engine.

name: Sovware
description: The organization, standards and infrastructure behind software and hardware you can own, inspect and run yourself.
